link.description: Industry-important LangChain concepts the CampusX playlist does not cover — gathered from LangChain's official documentation, not the video course. Covers the v1.0 create_agent architecture (middleware, human-in-the-loop, short/long-term memory, multi-agent subagents), LCEL gaps (streaming, retries/fallbacks, callbacks and tracing, caching), and retrievers beyond the ones the playlist demos (self-query, parent-document, ensemble). Every topic carries runnable Python.
